## DRM
### 0.3.2 Change Log
#### Global
##### Added
* Added Bank Editor for shared accounts, deposits, withdrawals, and editable deposit products.
* Added three built-in deposit presets with simple or compound interest.
* Added Real ticks and World ticks time bases for bank interest and deposit products.
* Added holding-time interest and depreciation with DNPC reputation rate adjustments.
* Added bank payments using DRM currencies, custom currency systems, or optional CobbleDollars.
* Added customizable bank GUI layouts and NPC bank assignments.
* Added the Go Bank dialogue action to open the speaking NPC's bank.
* Added custom multi-denomination currency payments and automatic change to shops and teleporters.
* Added shared currency-system selection and payment APIs for addons.
* Added editable teleporter cost summaries in GUI Maker.
* Added section dividers in GUI Maker.
* Added keyboard navigation for teleporter regions and destinations.
* Added destination travel costs using items, DRM currencies, or optional CobbleDollars.
##### Fixed
* Fixed faint seams between repeated DRM UI textures.
* Fixed dialogue text cursors jumping to the end when editing changes the text box height.
##### Improved
* Improved the teleporter travel menu with region tabs, destination previews, and clearer travel costs.
* Improved teleporter menu sizing and control visibility across GUI scales.
* Improved teleporter frames and controls with the shared DRM sprite skin.
#### Forge 1.20.1 / NeoForge 1.21.1
##### Added
* Added optional Create: Numismatics coin payments with automatic denomination conversion in shops, teleporters, and banks.
